      <div class="onecol-inner">
        <section class="paragraph-id-72736 paragraph--type--basic container--spacer container gutter paragraph container--block-basic">
  <a id="paragraph-72736"></a>
  <header class="hgroup hgroup--center hgroup--limited">
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><p>Fill your days with aquatic adventures from kite surfing and scuba diving, to snorkelling and kayaking, or experience all the&nbsp;on-shore&nbsp;activities&nbsp;Amanpulo&nbsp;has to offer including tennis, cycling, bird watching and a jungle obstacle course. At night, get up close to the stars with our astronomical refracting telescope.</p></div>
  </header>
</section>

and turquoise waters at Amanpulo, Philippines, with a solitary figure on the shore."></picture>
      </div>
      <header class="card__copy--with-accordion hgroup">
        <div>
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><h3>Unique Island Experiences</h3><p>Available for exclusive use, the floating bamboo Kawayan Bar was built for all-day lounging and enjoyment of the sea, as well as for one-of-a-kind picnics and private sunset cocktails. When the runway takes a break from its usual flight activity, it transforms into a racetrack for an exhilarating late-afternoon of go-karting. Feel the adrenaline speeding towards the horizon where sea meets sky, with a salty breeze rushing past at every turn. &nbsp;</p><h3>A tropical beach paradise</h3><p>There is no better balm for the soul than sunshine and sea. Powdery white sand beaches encircle the whole&nbsp;of Pamalican Island, ideal for circumnavigating&nbsp;Amanpulo&nbsp;barefoot. Umbrellas and sun loungers are positioned on the beach near the Beach Club, with its open-air pavilion and deck.</p><h3>PADI Dive Centre</h3><p>Pristine coral reefs stretching over seven square kilometres start just 300 metres from the island’s sandy&nbsp;shores, and crystal clear&nbsp;waters ensure excellent visibility. Amanpulo has its own PADI Dive Centre, and our scuba and snorkelling guides cater to all levels, including complete beginners.</p><h3>A nesting site for Green and Hawksbill Turtles</h3><p>Watching turtle hatchlings emerge from their nests and make their way to the moonlit ocean is a magical experience bar none.&nbsp;Pamalican&nbsp;Island is a nesting site for green and hawksbill turtles, visited every year from June to October by laying females.</p><h3>Exploring beyond our shores</h3><p>Adventure out&nbsp;in&nbsp;Amanpulo’s&nbsp;fleet of boats, whether on a sunset cruise, a fishing expedition or a sailing lesson.</p></div>
        </div>

      </header>
    </article>

      <header class="card__copy--with-accordion hgroup">
        <div>
      <h2 class="heading-h h3">Freediving Visiting Specialists</h2>
      <div class="hgroup__intro"><p>Valerie Bautista is a certified RAID freediving instructor, an internationally recognised credential that qualifies her to teach freediving through structured, safety-focused training programmes. Her certification reflects advanced expertise in breath-hold techniques, rescue skills and depth progression, ensuring students learn in a controlled and supportive environment that prioritises safety and confidence.&nbsp;</p></div>
        </div>
                  <div class="card__bottom">
                      <div class="card__multiple_links cta-links cta-links--1-col">
              <div class="link-wrap single-link field--media-text-links"><a href="/resorts/amanpulo/contact-us" class="cta__link card__link__cta underline" hreflang="en">Make an enquiry</a></div>
            </div>
          </div>
      </header>
    </article>
  </div>
</section>
